expires_today.title: Game Audio and SFX Treasure Trove by Tao & Sound
expires_today.long_description: The perfect audioscape for your next game, film, or creative project is only a click away with the SFX Treasure Trove Bundle by Tao & Sound! Create the next great AAA fantasy epic using the Medieval Fantasy 2 Audio Bundle, have a throwback platforming moment with the Super Retro Audio Bundle, or show players this isn’t your first rodeo with the Western Audio Bundle. Pay what you want for 12 can't-miss themed audio packs and help support Music Will with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Excel Automation 2026 Mastery Bundle
expires_today.description: Start optimizing your data with Excel
expires_today.long_description:
Do you feel a little behind when it comes to using Microsoft Excel? Level up your practical skill sets with the Excel Automation 2026 Mastery Bundle by Zenva. Remove workflow friction and supercharge your productivity with software courses like Intro to Excel Data Tools and Data Management, Excel Tables for Beginners, and Visualize Data with Excel Charts. Additionally, this bundle contains relevant AWS and Claude coding courses! Pay what you want for expert-led Excel courses and help support Alzheimer's Research UK with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before August 21, 2027.

expires_today.title: Audio Alchemy Vol. 2: The Ultimate Game Dev Audio Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
We brought back one of our most popular series for a limited time—create the perfect audioscape for your next game or creative project with Audio Alchemy Vol. 2, the ultimate game dev bundle of subscription-free sounds from Ovani Sound. Highlights from this extensive library of commercial-ready assets include the Epic Music Pack Vol. 2, Horror Music Pack Vol. 3, Unreal Music Plugin, and more! Explore a variety of genres, from funk to electronic and everything in between. Get the assets you need to achieve the sound you’re looking for, and support Children's Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before August 14th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Grimdark Trench Warfare
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Bring the battlefield to your tabletop with this bundle of printable trench warfare figures and environments from Hayland Terrain! Construct your trench systems and no man’s land with sandbags and tank traps, populate them with weapons specialists, highlanders, and demons, and sprinkle some fallen soldiers and sacrifices into the mix! You decide just how grimdark and curséd this conflict will get, and this bundle of 3D printable minis will help you bring it to life! (Or… undeath!) Make all your battlefield nightmares come true with this bundle at the price of your choosing, and support the Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Awesome Indie Adventures
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Looking for your next big adventure? Our newest bundle has our favorite indie games full of dynamic characters and exciting storylines for everyone ready to dive into a great story. Wield your bow and lift the curse on a mysterious island in The Pathless! Solve the puzzles to escape the Gloom in the retro survival horror game Post Trauma! Become the monsters you kill and rebuild a fallen civilization in Biomorph! There’s even more adventure to discover in this bundle, so grab these great games now at the price of your choosing and support music charity Reverb with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 28th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Short Games Showcase Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: A showcase of short, great games
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Don’t let life keep you from unwinding with a great game—cozy up for a quick session with our Short Games Showcase. Play Botany Manor, the cozy garden sim where you experiment with flora and fauna as a botanist. Try Anomaly Agent, the bloody good retro-inspired side-scrolling beat ’em up armed with an addictive synthwave soundtrack! Or connect with a friend for a co-op moment in Biped, the speed-and movement-focused puzzler. Pay what you want for 14 games that work around your schedule and help support Comic Relief with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 28th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: AI & Automation for Networking Professionals by Packt
expires_tomorrow.description: All about AI for Networking Pros
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Remove the friction from your everyday processes with an all-star collection of AI and automation learning courses from Packt! Start leveraging the AI capabilities of widely used platforms like AWS, Google Cloud, Python, Linux, and more with approachable, entry-level online training courses like Mastering Python Networking - 4e and Network Automation Cookbook - Second Edition. Pay what you want for elite learning courses, certification guides, and practice exams, and help support Make-A-Wish US, too!

expires_tomorrow.title: The Builder’s Vault by Hivemind - Unreal Engine Edition
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Level up your asset library with The Builder’s Vault Collection of detailed environmental assets specifically designed for Unreal Engine. Pay what you want for access to themed packs like Toskov: Post Apocalyptic City Megapack, Ravenhold: Modular Dark Fantasy Megapack, and more. Speed through your next development process with elite environmental assets and help support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!
